rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for a school pupil appointed to maintain discipline.

example.english: After Ming became a prefect, he often reminds us not to run in the corridors.
example.traditional: 阿明做咗風紀之後，成日提醒我哋唔好喺走廊跑。
